data.name: Dhron
data.gender_notes: Dhron is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dhron is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word ‘dhr’ which means ‘to hold, sustain, or support’. The name Dhron signifies a mighty and powerful individual, one who holds and sustains the universe. In Hindu mythology, Dhron is an epithet of the god Indra, the god of rain, thunderbolts, and power. The name Dhron carries the meaning “Mighty, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhron usually hope their child will grow to embody mighty, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength and power, one who holds the universe together.
data.etymology: Dhron belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mighty, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhron total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dhron, much like in its mythological connections to the god Indra, is a name that evokes power, strength, and might. It has been traditionally given to sons, reinforcing the idea of masculine power and dominance. In Indian culture, one's name is considered a significant part of their identity, and the name Dhron would undoubtedly leave a lasting impression on others.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Dhron holds a deep spiritual significance, reminding us of the divine powers that hold the universe together. It is a name that encourages us to embody the qualities of strength, support, and resilience, encouraging us to hold ourselves and our communities together through challenging times.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Dhron signifies the one who upholds righteousness and truth. It symbolizes the inner strength and courage to stand firm in the face of adversity, while maintaining ethical conduct. The divine guidance of Dharma, the Hindu law of righteousness, is present in this name.

historical_references.reference: Dhron is a name mentioned in the Mahabharata, the great Indian epic. He was a prince of the Panchala kingdom.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Dhron continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
